goals: Verify the Host UI successfully connects to the MCP server and displays the server name.
Verify the tool sidebar populates with available tools.
Verify that the first tool is auto-selected and its example JSON is pre-populated in the request body.
Verify that the tool list filters correctly when using the search input.
Verify that switching tool selection updates the input JSON and selected tool name.
Verify that the UI shows a validation error and disables the Run button for invalid JSON input.
Verify the UI shows a loading state during tool execution and displays the result upon completion.
